# Valid Task List Examples

- [ ] Unchecked task
- [x] Checked task
- [X] Checked task (uppercase X)

Using plus sign:

+ [ ] Task with plus
+ [x] Completed task with plus

Using asterisk:

* [ ] Task with asterisk
* [x] Completed task with asterisk

Numbered list with tasks:

1. [ ] First numbered task
2. [x] Second numbered task completed
3. [ ] Third numbered task
